title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・渾身のロングラン

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… I cannot believe this… My dream remains unfulfilled!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And she was the one who stopped me…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner is Mejiro Ryan! Mejiro Ryan takes first place! What an outstanding showdown between the fan-favorite Mejiros!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… I can't go on, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I can barely breathe… And my muscles…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… That distance, this competition… It was so tough…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think my body's gonna fall apart… Pant, pant, huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If it really took this much out of you, then I suppose I can accept my loss.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nothing vexes me more than to say this, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If someone had to get in the way of my dream, I'm glad that it was you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I reiterate that it pains me to say it! And I am not pleased about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-sorry, McQueen… But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I don't have any regrets. This race was just as important to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …I know it was. I would never forgive you if you held back today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you understand what this means? From now on, I'll be the one catching up to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right… I don't know how long I can keep this up…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I'll do whatever I can to stay in front! Like you always did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't want it any other way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will be the one who surpasses you, and at the distance you excel in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, then. Take care.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan pushes herself past her shortcomings to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next objective is the Takarazuka Kinen. After today's great achievement, getting the top rank in the fan vote is no longer a dream.
